description: This file defines a Flutter StatefulWidget called TrackingScreen used for tracking baby milestones and daily health logs. It includes UI components for date selection, input fields for sleep, feeding, notes, and buttons for submitting data. The code also interacts with an external ApiService for data submission.

classes.name: TrackingScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that provides a UI for tracking baby milestones and daily logs.

classes.name: _TrackingScreenState
classes.description: The state class managing the UI and logic for the TrackingScreen, including date picker, form fields, and submission handling.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the TextEditingController instances to free resources.

methods.name: _pickDate
methods.description: Displays a date picker dialog to select a date for the log.

methods.name: _submit
methods.description: Collects input data and submits it via the ApiService, handles UI updates on submission.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the tracking screen, including UI components and layout.
